I bought someone's old pre-built about 3 years ago and slowly replaced every part until it turned into this machine. It's not tippy top of the line but it plays everything I want it to play juuuust fine.

Trust me, for your next upgrade, you're going to really really really want to invest in an SSD.

The difference is night and day vs. 7200RPM. That's really all you need to be tippy top of the line, really, this build seems excellent and still has room for solid upgrades. I love it. Pics?
